name: Inquire at the Inn
summary: In Darkshire, Clerk Daltry sends you to the Scarlet Raven Tavern with a journal from Sven Yorgen's ruined farm. He hopes someone there can tell you who owned it.

sections.title: A Lead at the Scarlet Raven
sections.body: Clerk Daltry has finished examining the tattered book from Sven Yorgen's farm. He believes any stranger who visited Darkshire would have passed through its tavern. The Scarlet Raven Tavern is across town, the only gathering hall and lodging house in Darkshire. There, you may learn who came through and where they went.

sections.title: The Paranoid Guest
sections.body: Tavernkeep Smitts recognizes the journal when you show it to him. Its owner rented a room for several days and spent evenings scribbling at the bar. Then the guest fled Darkshire in terror, convinced an unseen pursuer was hunting him. His path led west along the road toward Raven Hill.

faq.q: Who sends you to the inn?
aliases: where does inquire at the inn start
faq.answer: Clerk Daltry, Darkshire's town record-keeper, sends you to the Scarlet Raven Tavern after examining the journal. He hopes someone there will recognize its owner.

faq.q: What is the book you are carrying?
faq.answer: The worn journal came from Sven Yorgen's ruined farmstead in southern Duskwood. It is believed to belong to the shadowy figure seen prowling nearby.

faq.q: Who runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts runs the Scarlet Raven Tavern, where he serves drinks and rents rooms to travelers who venture into Duskwood.

faq.q: What does Tavernkeep Smitts reveal about the guest?
aliases: what happened to the shadowy figure
faq.answer: The journal's owner rented a room for several days and spent his evenings writing at the bar. Then he fled Darkshire in terror, convinced an unseen pursuer was hunting him.

faq.q: Where did the shadowy figure flee?
faq.answer: The stranger fled west from Darkshire along the road toward Raven Hill.

faq.q: What quest follows Inquire at the Inn?
aliases: what comes after inquire at the inn
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts points you west to follow the stranger's trail in Finding the Shadowy Figure.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you help protect Darkshire, an isolated frontier settlement in the southern Eastern Kingdoms, by investigating threats within its walls.
As a rogue, you can follow a fugitive's trail from tavern talk to desolate ruins through careful investigation.
